bilging.title: Bilging
bilging.how_to: Tap a tile, then tap its neighbor to swap. Line up three or more of a color to clear them. Tiles float up from the bilge to fill the gap. Keep the water down.
bilging.how_to_keyboard: Click a pair to swap it. Arrows move the cursor, space or enter swaps with the piece to the right.
bilging.special.keg_help: Swap it to blow a 3 by 3 hole.
bilging.special.ink_help: Swap it with a piece to wipe every piece of that kind.
bilging.special.barnacle_help: Can't be matched. It rides up with the board and comes off on its own once it's above the water line.
bilging.hint_note: Practice rounds point at a scoring swap if you stop for a few seconds.
home.practice_sailing_blurb: Steer falling pairs onto the rigging's targets and line up fours. Two and a half minutes.
home.practice_carpentry_blurb: Lay planks over holes in the hull with as little waste as you can.
home.practice_gunnery_blurb: Steer powder, wad and shot from the chute into the cannons, in that order, and hear them roar.
home.practice_navigation_blurb: Turn the star rings so the falling stars chart the constellation.
practice.result_unverified: The ship's tally differed from yours. Its number stands.

sailing.title: Sailing
sailing.how_to: Pairs of sailcloth, rope and sea fall into the rigging. Drag left and right to steer, even under a platform, tap the piece to turn it, hold a swipe down to hurry it. Fill every outlined target on a platform with its color to clear it, and line up four of a kind in a row. Block the entry at the top and the rigging is cleared for a penalty.
sailing.how_to_keyboard: Left and right arrows steer, up and down turn either way, hold space to hurry.
sailing.legend_platform: A platform: a bar, a stack, an L or a square. Fill each outlined cell with its color to clear it; blank cells hold anything. Discs rest on the planks and slide in from the side.
carpentry.title: Carpentry
carpentry.how_to: Three planks wait in the tray. Drag one onto the hull and let go to set it down; the buttons under it turn it either way, flip it, and the hammer nails it down. Drag it off the hull to send it back, or tap the hull to move it there. Cover every cell of a hole to patch it. Planks hanging over sound hull or over each other are waste; a hole patched with no waste and no extra planks is a masterpiece. A hole left alone too long glows, then widens.
carpentry.how_to_keyboard: Move the mouse to carry a plank and click to nail it; right-click or scroll turns it, F flips it. 1, 2, 3 pick a plank, arrows move it, R turns, Q turns back, F flips, H jumps to the best fit, enter nails it down, escape puts it back.
carpentry.legend_holes: Dark cells are holes. Fill every cell of a hole; cells left idle too long widen it, and a widened hole can't be a masterpiece.
carpentry.legend_grain: Lines on a plank show its grain. Patch a hole with every grain running across for a bonus.
gunnery.title: Gunnery
gunnery.how_to: Pieces drop from the chute and roll until something turns them; anything you don't steer rolls out a hatch. Every round is on a different deck. Steer them into the cannons with arrows: powder, then wad, then shot, and the gun fires. Fire all four guns for a broadside. A wrong piece fouls a cannon until water washes it out. Tap or click toward an edge of a plank to point an arrow that way, or swipe across it; do it again to lift it.
gunnery.how_to_keyboard: Arrow keys move the cursor. W, A, S, D lay an arrow that way; Space or Backspace lifts it.
gunnery.legend_broadside: Fire every gun for a broadside: a gun's lamp lights when it fires, and when all four are lit the broadside scores {points} and the lamps go out.
gunnery.legend_order: Each cannon takes powder, then wad, then shot, and fires when full. A wrong piece fouls it; only water gets into a fouled cannon, and washes it clean.
gunnery.legend_arrow: An arrow turns any piece that rolls onto it. There is no limit on arrows; right-click lifts one.
gunnery.legend_badges: The badge on a cannon is the piece it wants next; the pips below show its load. When a piece is headed into a cannon its route lights up: green if the cannon wants it, red if it will foul it.
navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.how_to: Stars fall from the sky into the top of the chart and come to rest against the first star they meet, or at the center. Stars always pack toward the center: turn a ring so a slot opens under a star and it slides in. Drag a ring to turn it, or tap its right side to turn it clockwise and its left side to turn it back. Tap the falling star to bring it down now. A star on the hollow marker of its shape and color fills it; fill every marker and the constellation is charted. Three loose stars of a kind in a row clear.
navigation.how_to_keyboard: Up and down pick a ring, left and right turn it, enter or space brings the star down.
navigation.booch_note: If the outer slot at the top is taken when a star arrives, the whole column is swept away and it costs points. Keep the top open.
navigation.hint_note: Practice rounds show a hint when you pause: the ring to turn, and which way.
navigation.setting_markers_hint: Hide it to test your memory.
navigation.legend_marker: A hollow marker wants a star of its shape and color. Markers stay put; stars ride their ring and slide inward when the slot under them opens.
navigation.legend_landing: The ring at the end of the falling star's path is where it lands: gold when that spot is its own marker, red when the column is blocked.
navigation.legend_runs: Three or more loose stars of one kind in a row, around a ring or down a column, clear for a few points. Stars on their markers never clear this way.

harness.title: openseas harness
harness.tagline: The same engines, boards and server as the game, one puzzle at a time.
harness.result_lab: Lab round: not rated, and not a personal best.
harness.lab_invalid: The scenario does not validate; see the bench.
harness.scenario_blurb: A lab round runs in this browser only, with the seed, config and clock below. Rated and unrated rounds ignore all of it and play exactly as the game does.
harness.config_locked: Fixed: the board's animation timing is built on it.
harness.copy_failed: Could not copy; the address bar has it.
harness.clock_fixed: Rated and unrated rounds run on the wall clock, as in the game. Only a lab round's clock can be slowed, paused or stepped.
harness.round_none: No round yet. Start one above, or load a log below.
harness.inspector_log_hint: Every move with the engine's hash after it. Once the round is over, click a move to see the board after it.
harness.check_replay_ok: Replayed {count} moves from the seed: every hash matches.
harness.check_replay_diverged: Replay diverged at move {seq}: the engine is not deterministic, or the log was edited.
harness.check_replay_pending: When the round ends, its log is replayed from the seed and every hash compared.
harness.check_server_verified: The server scored {score}, the same as this board.
harness.check_server_differs: The server scored {score}; this board says {local}.
harness.import_blurb: Paste a round copied from a bench, or a puzzle_round row from the database, to step through it on this board.
harness.import_error_bad_move: Move {index} is not a valid move for this puzzle.
harness.import_error_wrong_puzzle: That round is for {puzzle}; open it from the home page.
harness.import_note_config_from_content: No config in it, so the content config was used.
harness.import_note_moves_from_row: Read the moves from a database row.
harness.review_diverged_here: the recorded hash differs from here on
